title: Launch safety: batch approve refuses blocked, do-not-contact and restricted drafts, an opt-out reaches waiting drafts, links go only to live pages, calendar fetches stay public
description: Fixes from the launch-machine audit of 2026-11-11. (1) POST /v1/flows/{key}/batch/approve refuses, with a reason each, a draft that is not waiting_for_owner (gate_blocked with the gate's reasons), a draft whose address, page, lead or host is on do-not-contact, and a draft for an EU, UK or Canadian lead; none reaches the outbox. It answers 404 for a flow key that is not shipped before it touches the filesystem. (2) An opt-out (a pasted no in the reply helper, a host.opted_out event) moves that person's waiting drafts in every flow to status do_not_contact. approveDraft refuses (409) and Today leaves off anyone on do-not-contact (the flow's own list and the shared neighborhood-activation list). (3) Live links only: Frequency's /start/host, /start/partner, /for/<niche> and /launch pages are not live yet; /create-a-space, /pricing and /help are. With funnels_live false in a flow's config.json or reply-tree.json, or FW_FUNNELS_LIVE=off in fwd's environment, every generated link to a page that is not live goes to /create-a-space with the same query tags; true keeps today's links. The shipped host-moments config sets it false; neighborhood-activation and its reply tree ship true because existing checks pin /start/host and /for/<niche>. (4) Host-moments notes and local pulse roundup drafts run checkDraft and store the gate result; a blocked one is stored gate_blocked. Heads-up drafts skip hosts on do-not-contact. (5) fetchCalendar resolves the host and refuses private, link-local, unique-local, carrier NAT and multicast addresses (any address the host resolves to), never fetches fwd's own port on loopback, and stops reading a body at its byte cap. (7) The draft gate's region check also blocks Canadian provinces and territories and UK nations and regions by name. (8) Today's Approve email batch shows who it goes to and, after it runs, the held and refused drafts with their reasons. (9) The intake engine refuses to start a paid run when the flow's budget is spent, like the reply engine. utm_source stays flowweb.
acceptance: Batch approve refuses a gate_blocked draft, a do-not-contact address or domain, and a UK or Canadian lead, each with a reason, and the outbox stays empty
Batch approve on a flow key that is not shipped answers 404 and writes nothing
A pasted no and a host.opted_out event move the person's waiting drafts to do_not_contact; approve answers 409 and Today leaves them off
With funnels_live false, generated /start/host, /for/<niche> and /launch links go to /create-a-space with the same tags; with true they are as today; the shipped host-moments config is false
fetchCalendar refuses private, link-local and unique-local addresses without fetching and reads no more than its byte cap
The draft gate blocks a region named Ontario, British Columbia, Scotland or Wales
